mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer_reminder ( id, customer_id, customer_name, user_id, user_name, reminder_time, content, status, created_by, created_time ) VALUES ( #{reminder.id}, #{reminder.customerId}, #{reminder.customerName}, #{reminder.userId}, #{reminder.userName}, #{reminder.reminderTime}, #{reminder.content}, #{reminder.status}, #{reminder.createUser}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id as customerId, customer_name as customerName, user_id as userId, user_name as userName, reminder_time as reminderTime, content, status, created_time as createTime, updated_time as updateTime FROM crm_customer_reminder WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY reminder_time DESC, created_time DESC

SELECT id, customer_id as customerId, customer_name as customerName, user_id as userId, user_name as userName, reminder_time as reminderTime, content, status, created_time as createTime, updated_time as updateTime FROM crm_customer_reminder WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY reminder_time DESC, created_time DESC

SELECT id, customer_id as customerId, customer_name as customerName, user_id as userId, user_name as userName, reminder_time as reminderTime, content, status, created_time as createTime, updated_time as updateTime FROM crm_customer_reminder WHERE status = 0 AND reminder_time <= #{now} ORDER BY reminder_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_customer_reminder WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
